?WORD4TODAY?

2Chro. 17v12 ESV
And Jehoshaphat grew steadily greater..

?
Your greatness isn’t seasonal… Its steadily being magnified.

?You see, it’s always good to GROW. When you go up, you fall but when you grow up, you stay up.

?
Genesis 26:13 KJV
And the man waxed great, and went forward, and grew until he became very great: (Isaac Grew)
?
Luke 1:80 KJV
And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, and was in the deserts till the day of his shewing unto Israel.(Jesus Grew until it was time of showing)

Many today do not want to “GROW”… they just want to ” GO UP”.

Grow until your time of showing.

??Pray,
Father, I declare steady and consistent growth in greatness.
Like Jehoshaphat, i will grow steadily greater in Jesus name..
